issues.title: Recompiler: packed pixel ancillary word read whole
issues.body:
Stray (PPSA02100, UE4) never renders past the loading screen and stops with:

```
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
  what():  ShaderRecompiler::Recompile: shader info collection failed: packed pixel ancillary input has an unsupported live use (used by SelectU32 ? ?)
```
issues.author: alice
